description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Dispute between A.M. Upali Attanayake and Tea Small Holdings Development Authority. 2. Industrial Dispute between C,W.A. Liyanaarachchige and Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation.
categorisation: This gazette content contains orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, which involves legal/regulatory matters. It specifically references statutory powers under Section 4(1) of the Act and appoints arbitrators to settle industrial disputes, falling under legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
